item.title: Express JS: Multiple Methods for Serving File Downloads to Clients
item.description:
“Express JS: Multiple Methods for Serving File Downloads to Clients”

When serving files for download via an HTTP endpoint in an Express server, ensuring the browser correctly handles the file (e.g., prompting a save dialog instead of displaying content inline) requires specific header manipulation or the use of built-in response methods. How can a developer effectively implement robust file serving capabilities in Node.js/Express?

How to Utilize res.download() for Simplified File Transfers?

The response.download(path [, filename] [, options] [, callback]) method in Express is designed to transfer files as an attachment. This automatically sets the necessary Content-Disposition header, telling the browser to download the file.

item.title: Accessing URL Query Parameters in Nodejs and Expressjs
item.description:
“Accessing URL Query Parameters in Nodejs and Expressjs”

When building web applications, especially with Node.js and its popular framework Express.js, you often need to retrieve data passed in the URL’s query string. These parameters, following a ? and separated by &, are crucial for filtering data, pagination, and more. For example, a URL like https://example.com/items?category=electronics&sort=price contains query parameters category with a value of electronics and sort with a value of price.

item.title: Express JS CORS: Effective Solutions for Cross-Origin Requests
item.description:
How to Implement Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) in Express.js?

When developing web applications with Node.js and Express, encountering Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) errors is a common challenge. These errors occur when a web page tries to make a request to a different domain, protocol, or port than the one it was served from. Browsers, by default, enforce the same-origin policy to prevent malicious activities. However, for legitimate inter-origin communication, you need to explicitly configure CORS. This post explores various effective methods to address CORS issues in your Express.js applications, from simple middleware configurations to utilizing the cors npm package.
